notes.title: Update: Bug Fixes & Balancing Adjustments
notes.content:
🚀 Bug Fixes:

Fixed an issue where some players using the English version experienced a bug preventing the spaceship from appearing.
⚙️ Gameplay Improvements:

Added more variety to spaceship upgrades.
Adjusted balance to improve the overall gameplay experience.
Enjoy the game, and thank you for your support! 🎮
